description: Tests first: scoped delivery with multiple connectors, disabled/archived/mismatch, fallback, session-only provider and email SMTP policy. comments.text: Simplification: remove notification-specific preflight event/callbacks and associated obsolete tests. Scope remains on recipient/outgoing.
